# Portfolio Website Project

Next.js 14+ portfolio website with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.

## Features
- Modern, minimal design inspired by premium developer portfolios
- Dark mode + light mode support
- Smooth animations and transitions
- Fully responsive (mobile-first)
- Clean component architecture

## Stack
- Next.js (App Router)
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- Framer Motion
